versions.content: AUTOSAR XML Namespace The AUTOSAR XML namespace for all AUTOSAR XML elements and attributes is http://autosar.org/schema/r<major>.<minor>. The namespace is kept across multiple releases of the AUTOSAR XML Schema as long as backward compatibility is kept. <major> and <minor> are the major and minor version numbers of the AUTOSAR release that starts a sequence of backwards compatible AUTOSAR XML Schema.
